review_findings.R3_registration_race: STILL_PRESENT, P2 static finding in R2-06a. NSIS lifecycle lock is target-parent-local; resource_trust.rs rejects an already registered same-domain other root at preflight; gogoke.nsi writes the shared domain HKCU registration much later. Two first installs at different parents may both pass preflight and later overwrite one another's registration. Deterministic cloud A/B barrier: both reach post-preflight, then finish A and B; require B rejection and A registration unchanged. Actual reproduction NOT_RUN. Fix requires domain registration custody held from before preflight through registration readback, retaining target-parent physical lock.
review_findings.R4_outer_job_creation: STILL_PRESENT, P2 static finding in R2-06a. Tauri managed_service in product_entry.rs creates suspended Node before AssignProcessToJobObject; a hard owner exit in that window can leave an uncontained suspended child. Native-host inner process creation was separately fixed and does not close this outer path. Cloud test must pause after CreateProcess and kill exact owner, then observe exact Node handle exit; reproduction NOT_RUN. Fix is creation-time same-Job assignment while preserving existing lease and cleanup semantics.
